adjudication.rationale: Four of five findings are rejected based on repository evidence showing intentional separation of governance scopes and semantic meanings. The entry object and schema correctly distinguish authorization of one exact next action from readiness of a separate decision candidate. The phase-a-r1 result correctly separates advisory recommendation from execution authorization.
